-464-
金融学（金融科技方向）专业“2+X”教学培养方案 
Study Scheme of Finance (FinTech Stream) 
一、培养目标及培养要求：I. Program Overview
金融学（金融科技方向）本科专业专注于金融领域科学数据分析和技术应用，本专业是全英文授课的金融学本
科四年制学位专业。
本专业培养德智体美劳全面发展的学生；要求学生掌握金融学和马克思主义经济学的理论基础与专业知识；熟
悉和了解国内外经济发展情况、金融学科的前沿理论和行业发展走向；掌握核心的管理理念和技能；具有一定的数
据发掘、信息整理和行业分析能力。毕业生也应具备跨学科的知识储备、实践技能、国际视野、创新思维、职业素养、
社会责任感和领导力，能够独立思辨、实践操作与终身学习。
我们的毕业生将能任职于顶级投资银行、商业银行、保险信托、证券等机构；也能胜任政府及企业财务管理或
咨询工作。同时，也可在商业分析、金融科技或法律等领域继续深造。我们致力于培养满足全球现代金融行业需求、
融通金融管理能力的高层次人才和未来杰出领袖。
FISF's undergraduate Finance (FinTech Stream) program focuses on scientific data analysis and technological 
applications in the ﬁeld of ﬁnance. This major is a four-year, English-taught undergraduate ﬁnance program.
The program develops students with a holistic education. Students are expected to understand the theoretical foundations 
and professional knowledge of both finance and Marxist economics, and are required to comprehend up-to-date finance 
theories and industry development trends both domestically and internationally. They will also be equipped with various 
technical skills, including data mining, information sorting, and industry analysis. Graduates should possess a broad range 
of interdisciplinary knowledge, practical skills, an international perspective, innovative thinking, professionalism, social 
responsibility, and leadership. They should also be able to think independently, practice their knowledge, and engage in 
lifelong learning.
The GBF graduates will be qualified for positions in prestigious investment banks, commercial banks, insurance 
trusts, securities, and other institutions, as well as in management or consulting positions in government and corporations. 
Additionally, they can also pursue further studies in business analysis, ﬁnancial technology, and law. We are dedicated to 
cultivating high performers and future leaders who can integrate ﬁnancial management and technical abilities to fulﬁll the 
needs of contemporary global ﬁnancial businesses.
二、毕业要求及授予学位类型：II. Graduation Requirements and Degree
本专业学生毕业时须满足通识教育课程（含通识教育核心课程和专项教育课程）43 学分、专业培养课程52 学
分（含社会实践与毕业论文模块15 学分）和多元发展路径课程的修读要求，总学分不低于132 学分（含实践学分
不低于24 学分；含美育学分不少于2 学分，其中至少在“美学和艺术史论类”或“艺术鉴赏和评论类”课程中修
读1 学分，并至少参与一项艺术实践活动；劳动教育不少于32 学时，并满足劳动周教育要求），达到学位要求者
授予经济学学士学位。
留学生的通识教育课程修读要求，以及留学生的水平测试要求，参见英文版培养方案和相应修读说明。
Students are required to complete 43 General Education Courses credits (including Core General Education Courses 
and Speciﬁc General Education Courses), 52 Major Courses credits (including 15 Practicum and Thesis Module credits), and 
satisfy the requirements of Multi-Development Track Courses. Completion of no fewer than 132 credits in total (including 
at least 24 Practice credits; 2 Aesthetic Education credits, including at least 1 credit in a course in ‘Aesthetics and Art 
History’ or ‘Art Appreciation and Criticism’ and participation in at least one practical art activity; 32 hours of Education 
on The Hard-Working Spirit credits and meeting the requirements for labor week education), a Bachelor of Economics degree 
is conferred to those who meet the requirements of the degree by Fudan University.
International students are required to complete 27 General Education Courses credits (including Core General Education 
Courses and Speciﬁc General Education Courses), 52 Major Courses credits (including Basic Courses in General Discipline 
and Professional Core Courses with 15 Practicum and Thesis Module credits), and satisfy the requirements of Multi-
Development Track Courses. Completion of no fewer than 116 credits in total, a Bachelor of Economics degree is conferred 
to those who meet the requirements of the degree by Fudan University.
三、课程设置与修读要求（132 学分）：III. Curriculum (132 Credits)
( 一) 通识教育课程(43 学分)i. General Education Courses (43 Credits)
通识教育课程包括通识教育核心课程和专项教育课程。
The Core General Education Courses and Speciﬁc General Education Courses are included.

-465-
1. 通识教育核心课程（27 学分）
a) Core General Education Courses (27 Credits)
要求修读27 学分，含思想政治理论课19 学分，七大模块课程8 学分（每模块最多修读1 门课程），课程设置
详见核心课程七大模块和金融学（金融科技方向）专业修读建议。
27 credits are required, including 19 credits from the Ideological and Political Theory Module and 8 credits from the 
Seven GE Modules (maximum of 1 course per module). Details are demonstrated in the Seven GE Modules Curriculum and 
the GBF Curriculum.
2. 专项教育课程（16 学分）
b) Specific General Education Courses (16 Credits)
要求修读16 学分，课程设置详见专项教育课程和金融学（金融科技方向）专业修读建议。
16 credits are required and more details are demonstrated in the GBF Curriculum.
( 二) 专业培养课程(52 学分)i. Major Courses (52 Credits)
专业培养课程包括大类基础课程和专业核心教育课程。
Basic Courses in General Discipline and Professional Core Courses are included.
1. 大类基础课程（19 学分）
a) Basic Courses in General Discipline (19 Credits)
要求修读19 学分。课程设置详见大类基础课程和金融学（金融科技方向）专业修读建议。
19 credits are required and more details are demonstrated in the GBF Curriculum.
2. 专业核心教育课程（33 学分）
b) Professional Core Courses (33 Credits)
要求修读33 学分，课程设置如下：
33 credits are required.

iii. Multi-Development Track Courses
多元发展包括专业进阶 、跨学科发展（含辅修学士学位项目）和创新创业等不同路径，要求在院系专业导师指
导下选择一条发展路径，按路径要求修读课程。
Regular Major Track, Cross-disciplinary Track (minor degree is included), and Innovation and Entrepreneurship 
Development are illustrations of diverse development directions. Under the supervision of an academic advisor, students must 
select a track and complete the necessary courses.
1. 专业进阶路径（37 学分）
a) Regular Major Track (37Credits)
修满37 学分。要求模块M1 至少修读15 学分；M2、M3 各模块至少修读3 学分，M2、M3 模块共计修读12 学分；
M1、M2、M3 三模块总计至少修读27 学分。若总学分不满37 分，可在学校所有本科生课程中任意选修10 学分。
专业进阶课程设置如下：
37 credits are required. A minimum of 15 credits is required for Module 1; a minimum of 3 credits for each of Module 2 
and Module 3, for a total of 12 credits for M2 and M3; and a minimum of 27 credits in total for M1, M2 and M3. If the total 
number of credits is less than 37, students are allowed to take any 10 credits from all undergraduate courses in FDU.

2) Free Electives (10 Credits)
学分不足可在学校所有本科生课程中任意选修，具体修读课程根据当年学校本科培养相关规定进行安排。
Should the student have insuﬃcient credits, s/he may take any of FDU’s undergraduate courses, which are arranged in 
accordance with the relevant regulations of FDU curriculum in the year.
2. 跨学科发展路径（37 学分）
b)Cross-disciplinary Track
修满37 学分。要求修读2 个非本专业独立开设的学程，可选择专业学程或跨学科学程。学分不足部分可在全
校所有本科生课程中任意选修。完成学程修读要求的学生可获得相应的学程证书。
学程课程详见教务处学程项目网页，下载地址：https://jwc.fudan.edu.cn/ （复旦大学教务处）专业培养- 常用文档。
37 credits are required. Two independent course packages oﬀered by other majors are required, with the option of a 
major program or a cross-disciplinary program. Any shortfall in credits is to be taken from all undergraduate programs in 
FDU. A corresponding course package certiﬁcate is awarded to those who meet the requirements. 
For details on the curriculum of the Cross-disciplinary Track, please refer to the academic website https://jwc.fudan.edu.
cn/.
3. 辅修学士学位路径
c)Minor Degree
要求至少修读本专业进阶课程M1 模块15 学分和1 个外院系开设的辅修学士学位项目。完成辅修学士学位项目
修读要求，且达到学校毕业和学位授予要求的学生可获得相应的辅修学士学位证书。
辅修学士学位项目课程设置详见教务处网页，下载地址：https://jwc.fudan.edu.cn/ （复旦大学教务处）专业培养
- 常用文档。
A minimum of 15 credits from M1 in GBF and a minor in a bachelor's degree program oﬀered by an external school are 
required. A corresponding minor bachelor's degree certiﬁcate is awarded to those who meet the requirements of the program 
and the university's graduation and degree award requirements. 
For details on the curriculum of the Minor degree, please refer to the academic website https://jwc.fudan.edu.cn/.

-468-
4. 创新创业路径 
d)Innovation and Entrepreneurship Development
要求修读37 学分。要求修读1 个非本专业独立开设的学程和1 个创新创业学院开设的创新创业学程，学分不
足部分可在全校所有本科生课程中任意选修。
创新创业学程课程详见教务处网页，下载地址：https://jwc.fudan.edu.cn/ （复旦大学教务处）专业培养- 常用文档。
37 credits are required. One independent course package oﬀered by another major and one-course package in innovation 
and entrepreneurship oﬀered by the Innovation and Entrepreneurship Institute are required, with any shortfall in credits to be 
taken from all undergraduate programs in FDU.
For the courses of the innovation and entrepreneurship programs, please refer to the academic website https://jwc.fudan.
edu.cn/.
5. 其他
e)Others
多元发展路径中，辅修学士学位项目或专业进阶课程模块均可以冲抵学程，专业培养和多元发展路径共享的课
程只计算一次学分。
In the Multi-Development Tracks, either the Minor Degree program or the Regular Major Modules can be oﬀset against 
the program. Courses shared across the Regular Major Track and Multi-Development Tracks are only counted for credit once.
